model: DPRC Series room dewpoint transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone DPRC series room dewpoint transmitters (PICS model DPRCB) with BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The DPRC is a Greystone room sensor that measures temperature and RH and calculates dewpoint, wet bulb and enthalpy, all reported as Analog Inputs over native BACnet MS/TP. Analog Values hold offsets, barometric pressure/altitude and the display mode; two Binary Values pick the units.
notes: Points from the object table on page 2 of the setup guide.
The object pages spell BV 1 and BV 2 as "Temperature Units" and "Enthalpy Units"; the table uses the singular.
Dewpoint, wet bulb and enthalpy are calculated from the temperature and RH readings.
Access from the object pages and PICS: AV and BV Present_Value are writable.

source.title: DPRC Series Room Dewpoint Transmitter - Setup Guide for BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC and baud in the menu, set the altitude or barometric pressure for the site, then read the temperature, RH and dewpoint AIs.
setup: Device instance is 381000 + the MS/TP MAC set in the menu; it stops tracking the MAC once written over BACnet.
MS/TP baud rates 9600-115200 are supported; Max_Master defaults to 127 and is writable.
gotchas: Atmospheric Pressure and Altitude are linked; set one to match the site so the psychrometric values are right.
Enthalpy units follow the enthalpy unit BV (kJ/kg or BTU/lb); temperatures follow the temperature unit BV.
